notes_for_editor: Brief record matches tnlandforms (420 ft = 128.0 m, Haywood, status gone). Only tnlandforms gives the tower's number and removal; the Forest Lookouts list names the community entry only. No dated events, build year, staffing or site description were found. Possible inconsistency for review: the Forest Lookouts list gives Belle Eagle (also Haywood County) as Tennessee Division of Forestry District 8, while tnlandforms numbers Sunnyhill 9-6. The story keeps the number in the list's district-and-tower format and does not state a district. Not corrected here.
